footer_guard: Free to play. This service gives no prizes or rewards of value. The creator chooses the cast independently of rank.
hero_desc: Take a quick challenge. Keep your record. Finish any mission this week to apply for a future recording.
art_caption: Open to everyone, on or off camera.
desc_no-rieul: Apple passes, strawberry fails. Answer 8 categories in Korean without the consonant ㄹ.
desc_telepathy: Are you thinking alike? Pick the answers you think most other players will choose.
desc_ore-hunt: Same ground, different choices. Follow distance clues to find 12 hidden ores.
casting_cta_title: Your story goes beyond your score.
casting_cta_desc: Records are a reference. Anyone who finishes a mission can apply.
rule_no-rieul_1: Enter a Korean word that belongs to the category.
rule_no-rieul_2: A ㄹ in the initial or final consonant, or a reused word, ends the run.
rule_no-rieul_3: 7 seconds per prompt, plus 1.5 seconds of network grace. The server scores the run.
rule_telepathy_1: Choose one of four options within 5 seconds.
rule_telepathy_2: Earn 100 points for matching the current majority. Tied choices all count.
rule_telepathy_3: Scores are provisional until the mission closes.
rule_ore-hunt_1: Dig up to 25 cells in 60 seconds.
rule_ore-hunt_3: An empty cell shows the distance to the nearest undiscovered ore.
free_only: Free entry · No monetary or material rewards
nickname_hint: Visible on the leaderboard. Avoid your real name.
word_hint: Enter a Korean word. No voice is collected.
ore_legend: Smaller distance means closer. Iron 10 · Gold 30 · Gem 100
result_timeout: Time is up. Your progress has been recorded.
result_invalid: That word did not pass. Check the category, ㄹ rule and previous answers.
result_complete: Mission finished. Try another challenge next.
provisional: Provisional score · Finalized at mission close
display_only: Ranking badges are for display only and carry no value.
leaderboard_desc: See mission bests and weekly totals. These rankings do not determine casting.
no_records: No records yet. Make the first attempt.
no_my_rank: Finish a mission to see your rank.
casting_title: See you at the next recording.
casting_desc: Finished any mission this week? Leave your records and a short introduction for the creator to review.
eligible: You’re eligible. Your best records this week will be attached automatically.
not_eligible_msg: Finish one mission this week before applying. Any score is welcome.
age_hint: Applications are for ages 14+. We do not ask for your birthday, so your birth year must make you 15 this year. Your birth year is not stored.
contact_hint: Used only for casting contact. Do not enter a phone number.
consent: I consent to contact collection for casting. Application details and contact data are deleted 30 days after submission.
casting_step1: Your weekly mission records are attached.
casting_step2: The creator reviews your introduction and records.
casting_sent_desc: Casting is not guaranteed. The creator will contact selected applicants.
studio_desc: Review applications and prepare the next mission.
logo_hint: Your own PNG/JPEG, up to 200 KB
ad_required: Every sponsored screen has a fixed advertising label. Entry fees and rewards cannot be configured.
report_note: Players are counted by device. Completion includes failed and timed-out runs with recorded results. Time and score averages use finished runs.
sponsor_title:
Let your audience
play your brand’s mission.
sponsor_desc: Bring an on-screen challenge to the browser. Viewers play for free; sponsors see engagement records.
sponsor_step1_desc: Choose one of three templates and set the title, color, your own logo and mission period.
sponsor_step2_desc: Review players, completion, average records and link visits in daily reports and CSV exports.
sample_note: Actual measurements are available in the studio. Public screens never show applicant contact data.
sponsor_contact_empty: Contact the creator about a sponsored mission. No payments are collected here.
faq_0_a: This site gives no money, goods, coupons or rewards of value. Ranking badges are display only.
faq_1_q: Does a high rank guarantee casting?
faq_1_a: The creator chooses the cast. Anyone who finishes a mission this week may apply, regardless of score. Recorded events are separate from this service.
faq_2_a: Entry is free, with three attempts per device per mission instance. There are no paid retries or randomized paid items.
faq_3_a: Play uses an anonymous device token and nickname. Casting is for ages 14+; contact details are used only for casting and automatically deleted with the application after 30 days.
faq_4_a: No. M1 supports text input only. It never opens the microphone or sends audio to the server.
faq_5_a: A fixed 광고 · Sponsored by label appears at the top of every sponsored mission screen. Entry rules remain the same.
